description: Controlled retrain of Condition A on the corrected Phase-1 pipeline: identical student, objective and budget, but the dataset is the corrected pilot_v4 (ids preserved, problem-grouped splits, verified near-duplicates, byte-pinned digests). Built FROM the untouched base only - never a continuation of Condition A - so any delta vs A measures the data corrections, not training order.

data.integrity_note: pilot_v4: 3807 train / 471 dev, 467 unique problems, 0 split crossings, 0 holdout collisions, 778 truncated final answers rejected, token audit ok at max_length 2048 (production Qwen3-1.7B tokenizer @ 70d244cc)

deliberately_changed.dataset: pilot_v3 (pre-integrity-fix) -> pilot_v4 (ids, grouping, verified near-dups, label audit)
deliberately_changed.micro_batch_grad_accum: 4/8 -> 1/32 (operator override measured on Condition A run 4; effective batch 32 preserved; recorded, not hidden)

comparability.evaluation: A2 is evaluated against the untouched base and Condition A with the frozen paired protocol (eval_protocol.py); training-loss comparison alone is never a quality claim

authorization.device_exclusivity_required: no other Chowder campaign may hold the target device

outputs.note: expected steps differ from A (3807 vs 4529 rows at the same effective batch): 2*ceil(3807/32)=240 optimizer steps

provenance_rules.from_untouched_base: training must start from Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B @ 70d244cc, never from the Condition A adapter
provenance_rules.no_synthetic_success: no metric may be derived from anything but measured artifacts
provenance_rules.no_auto_promotion: any claim that A2 beats A or base requires the frozen paired evaluation on the final split; the recorded decision is always requires_operator_review
